shared_elements: upright stone slab/pillar carved in low relief
weathered stone surface photographed in situ outdoors
repeated rectangular framed units arranged in a row/register
curved, rounded motifs contained within rectangular fields
organisation of the carved surface into horizontal tiers
justification: Both are tall, weathered stone monoliths carved in low relief and organised into repeated rectangular framed units set in tiers, which is the most specific correspondence (A's top row of boxed motifs versus B's stacked blocks). But A is dominated by large, sparse, isolated figures of animals and a human on a smooth pale ground, whereas B is an unbroken dense grid of small compact glyph-like cells with no figural scene, so the manner and overall impression differ sharply.
